```yaml
name: Publish to Ubuntu PPA

on:
  release:
    types: [created]
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  publish-ppa:
    runs-on: ubuntu-20.04
    steps:
      - name: Checkout code
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Setup Rust
        uses: actions-rs/toolchain@v1
        with:
          toolchain: stable
          override: true

      - name: Install build dependencies
        run: |
          sudo apt-get update
          sudo apt-get install -y build-essential libssl-dev libffi-dev pkg-config

      - name: Build project
        run: |
          cargo build --release

      - name: Create Debian package
        run: |
          mkdir -p debian/usr/bin
          cp target/release/mise debian/usr/bin/
          chmod +x debian/usr/bin/mise
          
          # Create control file
          mkdir -p debian/DEBIAN
          cat > debian/DEBIAN/control << EOF
          Package: mise
          Version: ${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}
          Section: utils
          Priority: optional
          Architecture: amd64
          Depends: libc6 (>= 2.27)
          Maintainer: mise Maintainers
          Description: mise is a tool for managing runtime versions
          EOF
          
          # Create postinst script
          cat > debian/DEBIAN/postinst << 'EOF'
          #!/bin/bash
          set -e
          # Post-installation script
          EOF
          chmod +x debian/DEBIAN/postinst
          
          # Create prerm script
          cat > debian/DEBIAN/prerm << 'EOF'
          #!/bin/bash
          set -e
          # Pre-removal script
          EOF
          chmod +x debian/DEBIAN/prerm
          
          # Build the package
          dpkg-deb --build debian mise_${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}_amd64.deb

      - name: Publish to Launchpad PPA
        uses: nick-invision/retry@v2
        with:
          timeout_minutes: 5
          max_attempts: 3
          command: |
            # Configure git for launchpad
            git config --global user.email "actions@github.com"
            git config --global user.name "GitHub Actions"
            
            # Install required tools
            sudo apt-get install -y dput debhelper
            
            # Create source package
            mkdir -p mise-source
            cp -r ./* mise-source/
            cd mise-source
            tar czf ../mise_${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}.orig.tar.gz .
            cd ..
            
            # Upload to PPA
            echo "${{ secrets.LAUNCHPAD_PPA }}" | base64 -d > ~/.lp
            dput ppa:your-launchpad-username/mise mise_${{ github.event.release.tag_name }}_amd64.deb
```
